summary: Comprehensive architectural and UX implementation plan for Barakah Nexus ERP — an All-in-One Enterprise ERP Suite featuring Inventory & Warehouse, Sales & POS Billing, Accounting & Ledger, HR & Payroll, Purchase & Supplier CRM, bilingual English/Bangla UI with BDT (৳) currency formatting, and an integrated Python FastAPI + SQLAlchemy backend code generator and exporter.
